name: John Love
bio: a Representative from Virginia; birth date unknown; pursued an academic course; studied law; was admitted to the bar in 1801 and commenced practice in Alexandria, Va.; member of the Virginia state house of delegates, 1805-1807; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Tenth and to the succeeding Congress (March 4, 1807-March 3, 1811); chairman, Committee on District of Columbia (Eleventh Congress); served in the Virginia state senate, 1816-1820; resumed the practice of law; died on August 17, 1822, in Alexandria, Va.; interment at Congressional Cemetery, Washington, D.C.
